title: fix(cli): keep config edits made between repeated harness setups
author: Drjacky

gist.summary: Repeated `polli harness <x> on` runs no longer cause a later `off` to overwrite config edits made between runs or delete a file that was created after the first `on`. The shared snapshot helper advances a file’s `afterHash` only if the file matched the stored hash when the repeated run began; untouched files still restore byte-for-byte. Existing snapshots need no schema change, and failed setup runs still leave the stored snapshot unchanged. The fix applies to harnesses using the helper, including Pi and OpenCode, with a regression test for each. The PR describes an `@pollinations/cli` version bump to 0.1.34, though the listed changed files do not include package manifests.
